- Find the names of sailors who have reserved all boats.

![formula](244,196,704,266) $$
P(R1, \pi_{\text{bid}} \text{Reserves} \div \pi_{\text{bid}} \text{Boats})) \\
\pi(R1 \times \text{Sailors})
$$

![list](268,268,681,287)
- Find the names of sailors who have reserved all boats called Interlake.

![list](262,370,698,387)
- Find the names of sailors who have reserved at least two different boats.

![formula](300,387,767,468) $$
R1 \times \text{Reserves} \\
R1.sid = \text{Reserves}.sid \text{ AND} \\
R1.bid \neq R2.bid
$$

![list](256,468,705,487)
- Find the names of sailors who have reserved the same boat at least twice.

![formula](210,488,715,603) $$
P(R1, \text{Reserves}) \\
T \leftarrow \pi_{\text{sid}}(R1 \times \text{Reserves}) \\
R1.sid = \text{Reserves}.sid \text{ AND} \\
R1.bid = \text{Reserves}.bid \text{ AND} \\
R1.day \neq \text{Reserves}.day
$$

![formula](262,607,687,703) $$
R \in \pi_{\text{name}}(T, \times \text{Sailors})
$$
